The local [Cytomine](https://cytomine.com) server is up and running!

Finally! We have our own server for hosting the whole slide images: visit
[CPath](https://cpath.recetox.muni.cz) to have a look.

Our ever-growing collection of pathology images has a new home. The
[Cytomine](https://cytomine.com) server has been deployed locally and it
already hosts more than 1,000 slides. It enables us a faster and more
convenient collaboration with colleagues from Pathology departments.
